study_name.notes: No canonical study name (e.g., EinsteinA_YYYY format) reported in the paper.

subject_id.notes: No individual subject identifiers reported; only aggregate cohort statistics given (n=77 AN, n=70 HC).

sample_id.notes: No individual sample identifiers provided in the main text or supplementary excerpts given.

pmid.notes: PMID not explicitly stated in paper body text; paper_id tag (37069399) may correspond to PMID but not confirmed within paper text.

subcohort.evidence_quote: It can be classified into two subtypes, the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
subcohort.notes: AN cases further subdivided into AN-RS (n=56) and AN-BP (n=21) subcohorts.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder with a high mortality.

control.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples...from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark from 1 September 2014 to 31 July 2016

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples

body_site_details.notes: No further anatomical subsite specified beyond 'faecal'/stool.

days_from_first_collection.notes: Study design is cross-sectional; no longitudinal sampling of human participants reported.

lifestyle.notes: Not applicable; not a traditional/non-westernized population study.

location.evidence_quote: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense University Hospital), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital) and Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg University Hospital)

probing_pocket_depth.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve dental/periodontal measurements.

westernized.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark
westernized.notes: Inferred from Danish cohort recruitment; not explicitly labeled 'westernized' in text.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Same exclusion criterion (3 months) applied to both AN cases and healthy controls (antibiotics within the last 3 months).

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: Protocol (IHMS SOP P7 V2) named but no specific commercial kit brand given for human faecal DNA extraction matching the enum list.

ncbi_accession.notes: No NCBI SRA/ENA accession number reported in provided text.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)
sequencing_platform.notes: Human faecal shotgun metagenomic sequencing platform; mouse 16S rRNA sequencing used Illumina MiSeq (Extended Data section), but human primary dataset used Ion Proton.

age.notes: Overall cohort age statistics referenced as being in Supplementary Table 1/2, not given as explicit numeric values in provided text. Individual donor ages for FMT experiment subset are reported (e.g., '20, 22 and 20 yr') but these represent only 3 AN and 3 HC donors, not the full cohort.

age_group.evidence_quote: Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital)
age_group.notes: Cohort likely spans Adolescent and Adult ages given recruitment from child/adolescent and adult psychiatric units, but exact age_group breakdown not explicitly stated in provided text.

age_unit.notes: No overall age value given, so unit not applicable at study level.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases
ancestry.notes: Term 'Caucasian' used verbatim in the paper; may correspond to broader 'European' ancestry category.

ancestry_details.notes: No more granular ancestry subcategory reported beyond 'Danish Caucasian'.

family.notes: No family-based sampling described in this study.

family_role.notes: Not applicable; not a family-based study.

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study
sex.notes: All AN cases and healthy controls were female; entire cohort (both subgroups) is 100% female.

zigosity.notes: Twin zygosity not relevant/mentioned in this study.

age_min.notes: No numeric age range for the whole AN/HC cohort was reported in the extracted text (only 'age-matched' description; details likely in Supplementary Table 2, not provided).

age_years.notes: Cohort-level mean age not given in extracted text; specific per-individual ages only reported for the 6 FMT donors (see samples).

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Inferred that all enrolled participants (AN and HC) had no current antibiotic use, based on exclusion criteria; same criterion applied to HC ('antibiotics within the last 3 months').

bmi.notes: Only qualitative statement that AN women were 'much leaner'; exact study-level BMI values are in Supplementary Table 2 (not provided). Specific BMI values reported only for the 6 FMT donors (see samples).

dietary_restriction.notes: Structured refeeding meal plans are described for AN in-/out-patients but do not correspond to a standard dietary-restriction category (e.g., vegetarian/gluten-free).

disease.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
disease.notes: Cohort consists of AN cases and healthy control (HC) women.

disease_details.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
disease_details.notes: AN-RS n=56, AN-BP n=21 per Fig. 1 legend.

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; this is not an oncology treatment-response study.

feces_phenotype.notes: No specific stool phenotype classification (e.g., Bristol score, diarrhea) reported; only bacterial cell counts and metagenomic composition.

fmt_id.notes: No individual participant IDs given for FMT donors; only group labels AN-T/HC-T used.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: we transplanted faecal microbiota from three randomly chosen AN-RS cases ... and three age-matched HC participants
fmt_role.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain and altered energy metabolism in mice
fmt_role.notes: Human participants served as FMT donors; recipients were germ-free mice, not human samples.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: Statement indicates birth control pill use was permitted (not excluded) for HC, but individual usage status not reported.

smoker.evidence_quote: including age, BMI, smoking and multiple drug intake
smoker.section: Results — Associations between absolute bacterial abundance and bioclinical variables in AN
smoker.notes: Smoking was recorded as a covariate but individual smoking status values not reported.

treatment.evidence_quote: Medication included selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines.
treatment.notes: Applies to a subset of AN patients as deconfounded medication covariates; exact per-patient assignment not given.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: women with AN were much leaner, had lower fasting serum concentrations of glucose and insulin, higher insulin sensitivity as estimated by homoeostatic model assessment for insulin resistance (HOMA-IR) and lower serum C-reactive protein
biomarker_name.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
biomarker_name.notes: Only directional comparisons (lower/higher) are reported in main text; exact numeric concentrations for glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR and CRP are stated to be in Supplementary Table 2, which is not included in the provided text. BMI values are quantified for the 6 FMT donor individuals only (see biomarker_value).

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m −2
biomarker_unit.notes: Unit given only for the BMI values of the six individual FMT donors (3 AN, 3 HC); other biomarkers (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP) have no unit specified in the provided text.

biomarker_value.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN (females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m −2 ) and three HC (females aged 20, 22 and 21 yr with BMI of 22.6, 21.1 and 21.2 kg m −2 )
biomarker_value.notes: These are individual BMI values for the 6 human FMT donors (3 AN-RS, 3 HC), not the full 77 AN / 70 HC cohort. This is a small illustrative subset, not representative of overall study-level BMI statistics (which are reported qualitatively as 'much leaner' without exact values in provided text).

disease_response_os.notes: This is an eating disorder/microbiome study, not an oncology survival study; overall survival is not applicable/reported. The paper mentions general AN mortality rate (5.6% per decade) but not individual/study-cohort overall survival duration.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; no OS data reported.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status is an oncology-related scale not used in this eating disorder study.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No field named 'feces_phenotype' with associated quantitative values distinct from the microbiome taxa/diversity findings was explicitly reported in a structured phenotype format in the provided text.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this study concerns anorexia nervosa, not tumors.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this study concerns anorexia nervosa, not tumors.

extraction_warnings: No per-sample or per-subject data table was present in the provided paper text; only study-level and subgroup-level (AN vs HC, and AN-RS vs AN-BP) aggregate statistics were available.

Several fields (study_name, subject_id, sample_id, curator, pmid, ncbi_accession, dna_extraction_kit for human samples, age, age_group) could not be extracted because the relevant details were referenced as being in Supplementary Tables 1-8, which were not included in the provided text.
The 'westernized' and 'age_group' fields were inferred rather than directly stated and should be reviewed.

FMT donor ages/BMIs for 3 AN and 3 HC individuals are reported in the Animal experiments section but were not used to populate the study-level 'age' field since they represent only a small donor subset, not the full cohort.
Batch 1 returned granularity='sample_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

The main human cohort (77 AN, 70 HC) is characterized at study/subgroup level in Supplementary Tables 1-2, which were not included in the provided text; therefore most demographic/clinical fields (age, BMI, smoking, medication specifics) could not be extracted numerically for the full cohort.

Only the 6 individuals whose faecal samples were used for mouse FMT experiments had explicit per-participant age and BMI values reported in the Methods (Animal experiments) section, prompting sample_level granularity for this subset; the rest of the cohort remains at aggregate/study level.

Some fields (e.g., zygosity, neonatal variables, tumor staging, HLA, obgyn variables) are not applicable to this study design (adult female AN/HC cohort with metagenomics/metabolomics and mouse FMT) and were marked not_reported.
antibiotics_current_use and obgyn_birth_control values were inferred/derived from exclusion-criteria wording rather than directly measured status; confidence set to medium.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

Most schema fields (ECOG performance status, tumor size, disease response/OS) are oncology-oriented and not applicable to this anorexia nervosa gut microbiota study; they are reported as not_reported.

Exact numeric values for many biomarkers (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP) mentioned in Results are stated to be detailed in Supplementary Table 1/2, which were not included in the provided text; only directional (higher/lower) comparisons could be extracted.
The study includes both human participants (77 AN, 70 HC) and a germ-free mouse FMT model; host_species was set to Homo sapiens for the primary cohort, but mouse experiments are also described.

BMI values were only explicitly quantified in the text for 6 individual FMT donors (3 AN, 3 HC), not for the full 147-participant cohort; these were reported as illustrative sample-level values, but overall granularity was kept as study_level since the bulk of extracted fields pertain to the whole cohort.
